caveat: Two GIII OS blobs now decode cleanly into genuine 3.71 OS images (CASIOWIN + version markers verified). They are NOT boot-tested, and no proven bootcode file exists (installers cannot supply bootcode). RCDATA 3072 and aux 3069 still fail to decode and are kept only as raw encoded resources. NO OS BOOT IS CLAIMED.

decoding.method: RFC1951 raw DEFLATE from byte 0, wbits=-15, opaque 8-byte trailer (public CG100 prior art)

provider_naming.explanation: arch_provider is an OPAQUE host dispatch string, not an ISA claim. This is the ID actually registered by the sibling SH3PLUGIN skeleton; keeping it preserves real dispatch. The 'sh3' token is a legacy project tag that conflicts with the verified SH-4A/SH7305 class.
provider_naming.rename_plan: When a real GIII core lands, register an ISA-correct id (suggested: giii.sh4a.core) and change only the arch_provider value in config.json. No host code change is needed.
